Spilled milk, bottles that don't seal properly, and nipples that cause colic or gas can quickly frustrate both parent and child. The 240ML Baby Bottle changes that reality by offering a practical, safe, and comfortable feeding solution built to keep babies happy and parents stress-free.

✅ EASY TO CLEAN – The wide-mouth opening makes cleaning and sterilizing quick and thorough. Parents save valuable time while ensuring the 240ML Baby Bottle always remains hygienic.





✅ PERFECT SIZE FOR FEEDING – 240ML The bottle balances capacity and convenience, holding just the right amount for a growing baby. It's compact enough for diaper bags, making feeding on the go stress-free.

1. Fill the 240ML Baby Bottle with milk or formula.

2. Secure the leak-proof lid and nipple.

4. Clean with ease and reuse for the next feeding.

Families using the 240ML Baby Bottle report smoother feeding sessions, less fussiness, and more time enjoying their baby instead of troubleshooting feeding issues. With its anti-colic design, natural nipple, and reliable build, this bottle gives parents peace of mind while making every meal a positive experience.

products.title: Baby Bottle Insulation Cover - Thermal Warmer for Pigeon Bottles
products.body_html:
Baby Bottle Insulation Cover - Constant Temperature Warmer

The PebbleTots Baby Bottle Insulation Cover maintains your baby's milk at the optimal temperature between feedings. This thermal warmer fits Pigeon and standard baby bottles, providing reliable heat retention for home use, travel, or nighttime feeds.

Constructed from high-quality, food-safe materials, this insulation cover uses passive thermal technology to keep milk warm without electricity or batteries. The lightweight, compact design slips easily into diaper bags, making it practical for parents on the go. Durable construction ensures the cover withstands daily use while maintaining its insulating properties.

Product Features

  • Constant Temperature Warmer: Keeps milk at the right temperature for longer periods.
  • Compatible with Pigeon & Standard Bottles: Fits most baby bottles.
  • Lightweight & Portable: Perfect for home, travel, and outings.
  • Safe & Durable: Made from non-toxic, food-safe materials.
  • Easy to Use & Clean: Simple to maintain for busy parents.

How It Works

The insulation cover uses thermal retention technology to maintain milk temperature after warming. Simply warm your baby's bottle to the desired temperature, then slide the PebbleTots cover over it. The insulated layers trap heat inside, preventing rapid cooling and keeping milk ready for feeding. This eliminates the need for reheating and preserves milk nutrients that can degrade with repeated warming.

Practical Applications

This bottle warmer cover serves multiple feeding scenarios. At home, it keeps bottles warm during nighttime feeds, reducing wait times when your baby is hungry. For travel, it maintains milk temperature in cars, airports, or outdoor settings where warming facilities aren't available. The cover also works well for daycare drop-offs, ensuring bottles stay warm until feeding time.

Care and Maintenance

The PebbleTots cover is designed for easy cleaning. The materials resist staining and odor absorption, and the simple construction allows for quick hand washing or gentle machine cycles. The durable fabric maintains its insulating properties through repeated washing, providing long-term value for busy families.

Ensure your baby enjoys warm, safe milk anytime with the PebbleTots Baby Bottle Insulation Cover.

PREMIUM GLASS BABY BOTTLE FOR SAFE, HYGIENIC FEEDING

The integrated vent system in the nipple minimizes air intake during feeding. This anti-colic feature helps reduce gas, spit-up, and fussiness. The wide caliber nipple mimics natural breastfeeding, supporting smooth transitions between breast and bottle.

The arc-shaped bottle design fits comfortably in adult hands and small baby grips. The wide neck opening simplifies filling, cleaning, and sterilization. Parents can thoroughly clean every corner without specialized brushes or tools.

DURABLE CONSTRUCTION FOR LONG-TERM USE

Glass construction eliminates chemical leaching concerns associated with plastic bottles. The material resists scratches, stains, and odor absorption, maintaining hygiene standards over extended use. The bottle withstands repeated sterilization cycles without degradation.

The Kidora PPSU Newborn Feeding Bottle delivers a safe, comfortable, and intelligent feeding experience for infants. Made from durable, BPA-free PPSU material, this bottle is lightweight, heat-resistant, and designed for long-lasting use through countless feedings.

Temperature-Sensing Technology for Safe Feeding

Equipped with a temperature-sensing feature, the bottle changes color to help parents ensure milk is at the ideal feeding temperature. This visual indicator eliminates guesswork and prevents accidental burns, giving you confidence with every feeding.

Anti-Colic Vent System Reduces Discomfort

The integrated anti-colic vent system minimizes air intake during feeding, reducing gas, spit-up, and discomfort for babies. This thoughtful design helps prevent colic symptoms and promotes more peaceful feeding sessions for both baby and parent.

Choke-Proof Nipple for Natural Flow

The choke-proof nipple provides a steady, natural milk flow that mimics breastfeeding, making feeding safe and smooth. The controlled flow rate helps prevent choking while allowing your baby to feed at their own comfortable pace.

Premium PPSU Material Benefits

PPSU (Polyphenylsulfone) is a medical-grade plastic that offers superior durability compared to standard baby bottles. This material is naturally amber-tinted, lightweight, and can withstand repeated sterilization without degrading. Heat-resistant up to high temperatures, it maintains its structural integrity and safety standards through extensive use.

Key Features:

  • PPSU Material: Lightweight, durable, and heat-resistant
  • Temperature-Sensing Design: Helps detect safe milk temperature
  • Anti-Colic System: Reduces gas & discomfort
  • Choke-Proof Nipple: Ensures safe milk flow for infants
  • BPA-Free & Safe: Perfect for everyday feeding

The Liniq Wide-Caliber Silicone Baby Bottle is designed to provide infants with a natural and safe feeding experience. Made from premium, BPA-free silicone, this bottle is soft, durable, and gentle for babies, making it perfect for everyday feeding.

Easy Cleaning and Maintenance

The wide mouth opening makes this bottle simple to fill with formula or breast milk and effortless to clean by hand or in the dishwasher. The silicone material resists staining and odor absorption, maintaining hygiene feeding after feeding.

Perfect for Newborns and Growing Infants

Suitable from birth onwards, this feeding bottle adapts to your baby's needs. The soft silicone nipple is gentle on sensitive gums while the ergonomic bottle shape is easy for parents to hold during nighttime feedings.

Nibby Portable Glass Baby Bottle – Thermostatic Milk Storage & Feeding Bottle

The Nibby Portable Glass Baby Bottle is the perfect blend of safety, durability, and smart feeding design. Made from high-quality borosilicate glass, this bottle ensures safe milk storage and long-lasting use, even under high temperatures.

With its thermostatic function, the Nibby bottle helps maintain the right milk temperature, making feeding time more convenient for parents and comfortable for babies. Its anti-colic nipple mimics natural breastfeeding to reduce gas, spit-up, and fussiness.

Lightweight, portable, and easy to clean, this glass baby bottle is ideal for home use or travel, giving parents peace of mind and infants a safe, natural feeding experience.

Key Features:

  • Premium Glass Material: Durable, heat-resistant borosilicate glass.
  • Thermostatic Storage: Maintains milk at a safe, warm temperature.

  • Portable Design: Easy to carry for travel and on-the-go feeding.
  • Safe & Hygienic: BPA-free and easy to sterilize.

Why Choose Borosilicate Glass?

Borosilicate glass is thermal shock resistant and can withstand rapid temperature changes without breaking. This makes the Nibby bottle safe for warming, sterilizing, and storing breast milk or formula. Unlike plastic bottles, glass doesn't absorb odors or colors and maintains hygiene over time.

Thermostatic Temperature Control

The built-in thermostatic function keeps milk at the optimal feeding temperature, reducing the need for constant reheating and making nighttime feedings easier. Parents can prepare bottles in advance knowing the milk will stay at the right warmth for their baby.

Anti-Colic Design for Comfortable Feeding

The specially designed anti-colic nipple allows air to flow into the bottle instead of into your baby's stomach, reducing colic symptoms, gas, and discomfort. The nipple shape mimics natural breastfeeding to support easy latch and smooth feeding transitions.

Travel-Ready and Convenient

Compact and portable, the Nibby glass baby bottle fits easily into diaper bags and cup holders. The secure lid prevents leaks during travel, making it perfect for outings, daycare, or visits to grandparents.

Choose the Nibby Portable Glass Baby Bottle for safe, stress-free, and natural feeding every day.
